title: Choose how Declutter looks and feels
question: One world leads; the others are alternates. Pick one, or re-roll for a fresh hand.

options.label: Weeding Slip
options.lineage: A library's weeding round: catalog cards, a red-ruled slip per item, a WITHDRAWN stamp
options.thesis: Removing things is a careful librarian's job: every item gets a slip with its reason, and only stamped items leave.
materials: catalog-card stock with a red top rule
options.viewport: Groups in a left rail; the open group as a grid of photo cards, each with one typed reason line; ticked cards carry a violet REMOVE stamp; detail panel on the right with the kept copy beside it.
options.risk: Light paper world can tip into nostalgic if the stamp is overused; it must stay the only flourish.

raised.raise: One text size for every item's facts; rank comes from weight and ink, not size.
A fixed capacity bar: what you've picked fills the phone's storage bar toward 'free', live.
Rail entries are sized by how much space each group holds, so big wins look big.
Facts sit in fixed cells that never move between groups: size, date, reason.

options.label: Contact Sheet
options.lineage: A photographer's contact sheet marked up with a red china marker
options.thesis: Reviewing your phone like editing a roll of film: frames in rows, rejects crossed in red, the keeper circled.
options.viewport: A dark film rail of groups; the open group as rows of frames on photo paper; ticked frames get a red X, the kept copy a red circle; edge-print numbers carry size and date.
options.risk: The most obvious metaphor for photos; it may feel familiar to anyone who has seen photo apps borrow film.

options.label: Plate Section
options.lineage: A design annual's plate pages: images as plates, hairline credit rows
options.thesis: Every suggestion is a plate with a one-line credit: the picture leads, the reason sits under it like a caption.
options.viewport: Thin top bar of group tokens; large image plates in a 4-up grid with hairline credit rows; selection is a periwinkle seal on the plate corner.
options.case: Fuses well: images lead with a caption reason, exactly the asked balance; loses on warmth, reads like a gallery more than a clean-up.
options.risk: Too gallery-like; tiny mono labels can hide the proof.

options.label: Terminal Wayfinding
options.lineage: Airport signage: yellow bands, black type, one decision at a time
options.thesis: A clean-up as a walk to your gate: one yellow band says the next decision and how much it frees.
options.viewport: A yellow band across the top: 'Next: Chat screenshots · 548 sure · 60 MB → Review'; below it the group's photos; decisions chain group to group.
options.case: Fuses well on flow (one safe pick, then the next decision) but the saturated yellow fights the calm you asked for.
options.risk: Loud; yellow everywhere tires the eye in a long session.

options.label: Timetable Slide Rack
options.lineage: A 1971 pocket timetable on a light table
options.thesis: Every fact at one size, ranked by weight and rule.
options.viewport: Raked slides of groups on a goldenrod bed.
options.risk: Raked containers make a review grid hard to scan.
options.case: Loses both: tilted slides fight scanning photos.
options.kept: One text size for every item's facts; rank by weight and ink.

options.label: Mixtape J-Card
options.lineage: A hand-lettered cassette inlay timed to fill a side
options.thesis: Picks fill a fixed capacity, like tracks filling a side.
options.risk: Handwriting reads playful, which you ruled out.
options.kept: A fixed capacity bar that fills as you pick.

options.label: Manual Tab Board
options.lineage: A boxed-software manual with a stepped tab rail
options.thesis: A tab rail whose tabs are as tall as their sections.
options.viewport: A stepped hue rail down the edge, acetate leaves over coloured boards.
options.risk: Seven hues is far from calm.
options.case: Loses both: too many colours, acetate obscures photos.
options.kept: Rail entries sized by how much space each group holds.

options.label: Split-Flap Board
options.thesis: Rows that flip in place; columns never move.
options.risk: Flipping motion reads playful; text-only rows hide pictures.
options.case: Loses both: no room for pictures, motion is a gimmick here.
options.kept: Facts in fixed cells that never move between groups.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean storage-cleaner app, done impeccably: white, grey, one blue accent.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar of groups, a photo grid with checkmarks, a blue 'Clean 2.6 GB' button.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every phone cleaner; trust has to come from the content alone.
